Opening hours


Our Visitor Centre is **closed**

The Iconic Signpost Experience & Penwith House – The

Signpost Shop are open daily from: **10:00am**

The Land's End Hotel, Bar & Restaurant are **open** daily from 08:00am

Our 4 fantastic family attractions are **closed**

for essential winter maintenance.

Our catering outlets & West Country Shopping Village are **closed**

Our 110 Acre Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty

and the coastal paths are accessible all year round

for your enjoyment.

The Land's End Hotel, Bar & Restaurant are **open** daily

_\*All site facilities are subject to weather conditions._

**Parking charges apply (Prices vary seasonally).**

_Please note: We do not take any pre-bookings. Tickets_

_for the car park are available to purchase when you arrive_

_on the day._

[Book Now](https://landsend.touchtakeaway.net/menu)

**Welcome to Land’s End!**

One of Britain’s best loved landmarks, famous for its unique location, natural beauty and stunning scenery.

There is plenty to offer those seeking a full day out – discover the cliff top trails, natural splendour, visit the fantastic value family attractions, and wander around the West Country Shopping Village.

## Wildlife

Land’s End is a legendary place for wildlife watchers so keep an eye open for Gannets, Fulmars, Kittiwakes, Shags, Razorbills and even the rare Cornish Chough.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/nature/wildlife/)

## Walks

An ‘Area of Oustanding Natural Beauty’ surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean to the north, south and west, Land’s End is a fantastic location for walkers and explorers.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/nature/walks/)

## Natural Land’s End

Natural Land’s End is only a short walk from our main visitor centre and our designated pathways will lead you to discover some truly breathtaking views on clear days.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/nature/wildlife/)

## Coastal Landscape

The Land’s End Peninsula was formed around 270 million years ago, producing classic rocky coastal scenery and magnificent cliffs that are of national significance.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/nature/coastal-landscape/)

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/whats-on/magic-in-the-skies/)

## 4D Film Experience: Jolly Roger

In 4D cinema you don’t just watch a movie – with squirting water, air blasts, seat movement and more, you’ll feel like you’re right there in the middle of the story.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/attractions/4d-film-experience-jolly-roger/)

## Greeb Farm

Make friends with a loveable collection of small animals at this restored 200-year-old Cornish farmstead situated just a short walk along the headland.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/attractions/greeb-farm/)

## End to End Story

Enjoy our interactive display to the countless End to End adventurers who have completed this iconic 800-mile journey.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/attractions/end-to-end-story/)

## The Iconic Signpost

Made famous by the thousands of celebrity End-to-Enders and their remarkable journeys from John O‘Groats, generations of visitors have paid to take home a unique photo record of their time at Land’s End.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/attractions/the-iconic-signpost/)

## The Lost Treasure of Lyonesse, a Golf Adventure!

Journey back in time to discover the myth of the lost city of Lyonesse and its forgotten treasures that were consumed by the ocean centuries ago.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/attractions/golf-adventure/)

## The Cafe

Relax in our newly refurbished Cornish Cafe, overlooking Greeb Farm and the Atlantic Ocean towards Wolf Rock lighthouse.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/eat/quick-bites/)

## First & Last Inn

The First & Last Inn is one of the most legendary 17th century inns in Britain, where you can enjoy fantastic home-cooked food, local real ales and live music.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/eat/first-last-inn/)

Looking for some light refreshment? Grab a Cornish pasty or fresh doughnut at our kiosks, or head to our ice cream parlour for a scoop of delicious Cornish ice cream.

At our Greeb Farm studios, Land’s End hosts a very talented team of independent local artists and craftspeople producing handmade gifts for you to choose from.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/shop/craftworkers/)

## West Country Shopping Village

In the charming old-world surroundings of our West Country Shopping Village, we’ll tempt you with three specialist shops offering quality products from local suppliers.

[Discover More](https://landsend-landmark.co.uk/shop/west-country-shopping-village/)

Originally built in 1860 as a Temperance Hotel for Victorian visitors, Penwith House is a charming shop to browse nautically-themed gifts, souvenirs and confectionery.
